conbody.p: To equalize tread wear, it is recommended that the tires be rotated every 10,000 km (6,500 miles) or sooner if irregular wear develops.
After rotation, be sure to bring the front and rear tire pressure to specification and check nut torque (proper torque is 11–13 kgf·m [79–94 lbf ·ft]).

li.p: Do not use the compact spare tire for tire rotation.
Do not mix bias ply and radial ply tires under any circumstances. This may cause unusual handling characteristics that could result in death, severe injury, or property damage.

note.p: Rotate radial tires that have an asymmetric tread pattern only from front to rear and not from right to left.
